result.brief: 提出统一世界-动作模型，将3D场景流作为与视觉、动作并列的第三模态，通过多专家扩散Transformer与联合注意力共享表征，并支持策略、正逆动力学与未来视觉特征/流预测等多种角色。
result.reason: Unified world-action diffusion transformer with per-modality experts and joint attention; 3D scene flow as third modality alongside future visual features, giving a multimodal world representation.
